messages:
acme-sre: Hey team — after we rotated IdP signing certs this morning a subset of users (EU region) get 403 when SSOing into our app. Error in the browser: "SAML assertion audience or recipient mismatch". Can you triage?
eden-cs: Sorry you're hitting this, can you paste the exact Assertion Recipient and Audience you see in the logs + tenant id?
acme-sre: Tenant: acme-prod-42. From our edge logs: 'recipient=https://app.acme.internal/sso/callback' but the assertion Audience is 'https://app.acme.internal/'. Also seeing a few responses with recipient 'https://app.acme.internal/sso/callback/' (trailing slash).
samir-sre: Quick theory: our metadata poller may be caching a 302'd metadata payload served by their CDN that rewrites Host header -> downstream watcher saved metadata with wrong entityID/host. Can you share the IdP metadata URL?
acme-sre: https://idp.acme-cdn.net/saml/metadata (they put IdP behind a global CDN).
idp-watchdog-bot: metadata-poller: last_fetch=1755555400 status=200 checksum=sha256:aa12... previous_checksum=sha256:bb34... fetched_via=302 -> host=idp-edge-1.acme-cdn.net
eden-cs: That poller line looks suspicious: fetched_via=302 + host rewrite. If the CDN rewrote the entityID or normalized the entityDescriptor to a host alias we could end up accepting the wrong <EntityDescriptor entityID>.
acme-sre: We confirmed the IdP team recently enabled origin rewrite rules. Their metadata at the canonical origin returns entityID 'https://idp.acme.internal' but the CDN front returns 'https://idp-edge-1.acme-cdn.net' in the metadata file body.
tori-eng: Actionable steps: 1) short-term: allow the trailing-slash variant and canonical root audience as accepted recipients for that tenant so users can sign in while we fix the metadata ingestion. 2) medium-term: change metadata poller to validate that the entityID in the XML matches the requested host unless an explicit host-alias mapping exists. 3) hardening: record both the provenance host (request URL) and the entityID and surface a warning when they differ.
samir-sre: Repro steps I used locally:
```
curl -i -L -H "Host: idp.acme.internal" "https://idp.acme-cdn.net/saml/metadata"
# look for <EntityDescriptor entityID=...> and check for host mismatch
```
Logs snippet we saw on prod:
```
ERROR 1755555422 saml: Received assertion: Audience="https://idp.acme.internal/" Recipient="https://app.acme.internal/sso/callback" -> audience check failed
INFO 1755555423 metadata: fetched from https://idp.acme-cdn.net/saml/metadata served-by=idp-edge-1.acme-cdn.net entityID=https://idp-edge-1.acme-cdn.net
```
eden-cs: For the immediate workaround I've created a temporary tenant-mapping entry: allow_recipient_variants=["https://app.acme.internal/sso/callback/","https://app.acme.internal/sso/callback"], and flagged the tenant for manual sync. Can you verify if logins succeed in ~5m?
acme-sre: Trying now — one login succeeded, one still 403. Sharing the failing assertion (redacted): recipient has trailing slash, audience has canonical root.
tori-eng: I'm going to push a small change to the metadata watcher on staging to 1) treat 302 followed by Host header changes as a mismatch and 2) emit a paged alert. If that looks good we'll roll prod. Samir, can you run the staging poller against their CDN and origin and paste diffs?
samir-sre: Done — staging diff shows entityID mismatch and different <KeyDescriptor> order (the CDN drops the optional <dsig:Signature> wrapper). I'll attach diffs to the ticket.
idp-watchdog-bot: incident created: INC-2026-2156 metadata-mismatch-acme-prod-42 assigned->eng-runtime priority=high
eden-cs: Escalating to eng-runtime for a patch and to coordinate with Acme's IdP team to stop rewrites. I've also opened a billing-friendly rollback window in case we need to revert the tenant mapping.
acme-sre: Appreciate it — we'll ask our IdP vendor to disable origin-rewrite for the metadata path. Any ETA on the watcher patch?
tori-eng: If staging looks green we can promote in ~90m. I'll post a canary and ask for monitoring on 2xx SSO flows.
eden-cs: Follow-ups: (a) acme to confirm CDN rewrite disabled, (b) eng to ship watcher change, (c) support to remove temporary recipient override after patch. Tracking in INC-2026-2156. :thumbsup:
acme-sre: Will confirm with IdP and update here. Thanks for the quick turnaround.
